$comment: Curated community benchmark library for the Atlas Benchmark UI. Entries with source 'local' point at directories that already exist on this machine (paths relative to the monorepo root); entries with source 'git' are shallow-cloned into an isolated temporary workspace when a benchmark runs, and cleaned up afterwards. Availability is checked live (filesystem / git ls-remote) — never assume. Do not add measured statistics here; files, languages, and benchmark numbers are read from real indexes and real suite results.
